chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Muthanna ibn Al-Walid, from Al-Hasan Al-Sayqal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked: A woman left behind her husband and her two parents. He said: 'For the husband is half, and for the mother is one-third, and for the father is one-sixth.'
ai.seo_question: How is inheritance divided when a woman dies leaving her husband, mother, and father?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq clarifies the specific shares of the husband, mother, and father when all three coexist as heirs, a scenario that requires careful application of the Quranic verses in Surah An-Nisa. In Shia jurisprudence, this distribution highlights the principle that the father's share is fixed at one-sixth in this configuration, while the mother receives one-third of the total estate (not one-third of the remainder), ensuring the husband's half is calculated on the gross estate. This hadith is frequently cited to resolve potential ambiguities regarding the 'residuary' nature of the father when he inherits alongside a spouse and parents.
